tldr: Postman moved to Free/Solo/Team/Enterprise plans on March 1, 2026. Free is now limited to 1 user and cannot create a team (before, up to 3 people). Collection runs and mock servers became unlimited on all plans. Team costs $19/user/month billed annually. The Enterprise price was replaced by 'Contact sales' around Sep 19, 2026. The pains that keep coming back are: forced account and cloud dependency (Scratch Pad removed Sep 15, 2023; Postman down during the Oct 20, 2025 AWS outage), secrets leaking through public workspaces, a heavy app that hangs on large payloads, an AI popup that could not be closed, closed exports and frequent pricing changes. People who leave mostly go to Bruno (plain files in Git, offline, no account), then Yaak, Insomnia/Insomnium, Hoppscotch, Hurl, HTTPie/xh, Kreya and .http files.

tiers.name: Team
tiers.price: $19/user/month billed annually (also sold through AWS Marketplace). Unlimited users and viewers. Basic RBAC. SSO only through the 'Simple Security' add-on at $6/user/month. Private and Partner workspaces are listed as unavailable on Team (from a partial page parse; verify)

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.price: 'Contact sales for pricing'. It was $49/user/month billed annually until the change detected Sep 19, 2026, which also removed self-serve buying

pricing.billing_notes: The annual toggle says 'Save up to 25%'. Monthly-billing prices for Solo and Team were not visible in the fetched text. Paid usage rates: AI overage $0.05 (Solo), $0.04 (Team), $0.035 (Enterprise) per credit; '$1 per 1000 Flows credits'; cloud performance testing $0.04 per virtual-user hour; '$20 per 50,000 requests / team / month' (probably monitor overage). Source: https://www.postman.com/pricing/
pricing.paid_tier_limits: Solo / Team / Enterprise: AI credits 400/mo, 400/user/mo, 800/user/mo pooled. Flows credits 50/mo, 100/team/mo, 500/team/mo. Monitor requests 10,000/mo on all three. Postman API calls 100k, 1M, 10M. Integrations up to 10, 50, 100. Deleted-collection recovery 30, 90, 90 days. Insights and the Private API Network are Enterprise-only. Support is Community & Email except Enterprise, which gets 24x5 with a 24h SLA. Source: https://www.postman.com/pricing/

plan_changes_timeline.change: Plans and pricing update (HN, 97 points). Older, low relevance
Local collection runner capped at 25 runs/month on Free/Basic, 250 on Professional. Strong backlash

CEO Abhinav Asthana announced the Scratch Pad sunset. New downloads had no Scratch Pad from May 15, 2023. It was replaced by the Lightweight API Client (v10.14): HTTP/GraphQL/gRPC/WebSocket with local history, but no collections or environments without signing in. Stated reason: keeping two architectures cost '2x-4x the amount of time'
Scratch Pad removed. Collections and environments now require an account and cloud sync
Backlash over the forced account (Tell HN, 365 points, 173 comments)
Postman started secret scanning with notifications and began removing public workspaces with detected secrets after warning the owners
About 15h12m incident during the AWS outage: desktop and browser clients and login affected, workspaces not loading
Agent Mode AI onboarding popup with no close button. Postman later said it had been removed and disabled
Announced new plans and v12 features for March 1: Git-native, AI, built-in terminal, local and CI mock servers, GraphQL/gRPC/WebSocket/MQTT/MCP, CLI, Insights, API Catalog

New plans live. Free limited to 1 user with no team. Unlimited collection runs and mock usage on all plans. Add-ons folded into plans. Basic and Professional closed to new customers: Basic moves to Team 'over time', Professional can renew. Partner Workspaces included in Enterprise, and partners do not take paid seats
Cloud load testing split out as a usage-billed add-on at $0.04/VuH

Public Enterprise price of $49/user/month removed and replaced by 'Contact sales'. Self-serve and AWS buying of Enterprise removed. PricingSaaS counts 11 pricing changes since Apr 2024, 8 of them in the last 12 months

pain_points: Forced account: since Sep 15, 2023 collections and environments need sign-in. Signed out, only the Lightweight API Client works, with no collections or environments. [high] https://blog.postman.com/announcing-new-lightweight-postman-api-client/

Perceived data loss on forced sign-up: 'When I declined, it wiped all my collections' (HN, Oct 2023, 365 points). Postman staff said the data was safe and could be migrated. [medium] https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=37792690

Data-sovereignty bans: 'DO NOT want the information stored on a 3rd party server' (Sep 2023); 'forbidden tool in many corporations' (HN 2025); 'asked us to uninstall when postman switched to online'. [high] https://community.postman.com/t/losing-users-after-sunsetting-scratch-pad/52618 ; https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=44005654 ; https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45645172

Cloud dependency: Postman was down for local work during the Oct 20, 2025 AWS outage. 'If it stops working locally, what even is the point anymore?' (HN, 537 points). [high] https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45645172 ; https://pingoru.io/providers/postman/incidents/26594

Secrets leaked through public workspaces: 30,000+ workspaces exposed tokens and keys, including GitHub (5,924), Slack (5,552) and Salesforce (4,206) (CloudSEK, Dec 23, 2024). [high] https://cloudsek.com/blog/postman-data-leaks-the-hidden-risks-lurking-in-your-workspaces

Confusing secret UX: 'secret' variables are only masked on screen, and 'Initial value' is synced to the cloud and visible to everyone in the workspace. 1,689 live credentials were verified in about 40k workspaces, with an estimate of at least 4,000. Postman's scanner warns only after publishing. [high] https://trufflesecurity.com/blog/postman-carries-lots-of-secrets

Unclear telemetry: users ask to know 'exactly what data is sent to Postman servers' and want a full opt-out. A May 2025 claim that Postman logs secrets was disputed by the founder and is unverified. [medium] https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45652555 ; https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=44005654

Free plan is 1 user since Mar 1, 2026 (was up to 3). Any sharing needs Team at $19/user/month billed annually; Apidog, a competitor, estimates a 3-person team at $684/yr. [high] https://learning.postman.com/docs/billing/about-plans ; https://www.postman.com/pricing/ ; https://apidog.com/blog/postman-free-plan-2026-one-user-limit/

Pricing churn and opacity: 11 changes since Apr 2024, the Enterprise price hidden in Sep 2026, and past caps on local-only features ('requires absolutely no resources from Postman's servers'). [high] https://pricingsaas.com/news/article/postman-pulls-its-49-enterprise-price-routes-the-tier-to-sales ; https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=34875153

Billing dispute (G2, Aug 2026): 'charged an extortionate amount after not using the product for over a year', with the refund refused. [low, single review] https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/reviews/reviews-list/prodview-2nezdpu4cqcac?page=14

Heavy RAM/CPU use: the 'Eating too much RAM' issue has been open since 2018 and was still reported on 12.19.4 in July 2026. 'postman is slow, eats a ton of memory' (HN 2025). G2 reviewers call it 'resource-intensive'. [high] https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-app-support/issues/4687 ; https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45645172

Large payloads crash or hang the UI: a 250 MB response fills memory and crashes the app (Jun 2025), long base64 variables hang it (Dec 2025), very long query params hang it (Sep 2025), and JSON over 1 MB freezes it (HN 2024). [high] https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-app-support/issues/13632 ; https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-app-support/issues/13943 ; https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-app-support/issues/13784 ; https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=39653718

Slow at scale: collection search is sluggish and freezes (Mar 2026), and large collections lag (G2 2026). [medium] https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-app-support/issues/14030 ; https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/reviews/reviews-list/prodview-2nezdpu4cqcac?page=14

Bloat: 'the whole Postman UI has become an overcomplicated mess' (HN 2024). G2 2026: 'vast number of features makes it a bit complex' and 'interface can feel overwhelming'. [high] https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=39653718 ; https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/reviews/reviews-list/prodview-2nezdpu4cqcac?page=14

Forced AI: an Agent Mode popup with no close button kept coming back even with AI disabled. 'Why is this an opt-out feature instead of an opt-in feature?' [high] https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-app-support/issues/13835
No control over updates: 'Option to disable auto updates' has been open since 2019 (94 comments). [high] https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-app-support/issues/6999

Export lock-in: collections with WebSocket or gRPC requests cannot be exported. The issue has been open since Sep 2022 (106 comments) and was still being requested in Jul 2026. [high] https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-app-support/issues/11252
Team lock-in: teams stay because their shared collections live inside Postman, and collaboration means paying per seat. [medium] https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45645172

Sync problems: the v8 Sync/WS issue is still open (128 comments), 'Workspaces not loading' (Oct 2025), and a Capterra Feb 2026 review mentions team sync problems. [medium] https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-app-support/issues/9481 ; https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-app-support/issues/13821

Offline still partial: 'can't use postman offline after signing in'. v12 Native Git keeps local files but still syncs with Postman Cloud and works only in the desktop app. [medium] https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-app-support/issues/13835 ; https://learning.postman.com/latest-v-12/docs/use/native-git/overview.md

Trust erosion: 'Postman became enshittified, so we switched to Insomnia'. Users fear that every free tool will eventually do the same ('rugpull'). [medium] https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45645172 ; https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=39653718

Electron weight: Apidog, a competitor, claims about 280 MB at launch and 450-600 MB with 3 collections (unverified). Separately, every Postman version crashes on Windows 11 build 26200 with a GPU-process failure (May 2026). [low] https://apidog.com/blog/postman-slow-bloated-2026-alternatives/ ; https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-app-support/issues/14149
Sign-in friction: the 'sign in button is disabled' bug (Aug 2026) blocks all use because login is mandatory. [low, single issue] https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-app-support/issues/14252

alternatives.name: Bruno
alternatives.why_people_move: Offline-only. Collections are plain-text .bru files kept in Git. No cloud, no account, MIT licence, no VC money (the creator says he turned down about 10 VC approaches). 'no pay-to-remove limits'. Has a CLI for CI. It is the most-recommended alternative in every thread (launch on HN: 1,538 points, Mar 2024)
alternatives.what_they_miss_or_risks: In 2024 comments: no cookies, WebSockets or SSE, and weaker scripting. People worry about the closed-source paid 'Golden Edition'. One 2025 user 'lost all my work because of a bug'

alternatives.name: Yaak
alternatives.why_people_move: Made by Insomnia's creator: 'fully offline, no telemetry, open source, and can even sync with Git'
alternatives.what_they_miss_or_risks: Doubts about long-term independence. Paid terms apply only to the prebuilt binaries

alternatives.name: Insomnia / Insomnium
alternatives.why_people_move: It was the 2023 escape route ('migrated to insomnia.rest when postman required logging in'). Insomnium is a fork with no sign-up
alternatives.what_they_miss_or_risks: Insomnia added a forced login in 2023 and users reported lost requests: 'the cycle continues'

alternatives.name: Hoppscotch
alternatives.why_people_move: Open source, self-hostable, Postman-style UI (HN: 668 points in 2022, 177 points in Feb 2025)
alternatives.what_they_miss_or_risks: Needs a browser extension for CORS ('I don't want to install an extension'). Seen as online-first. VC concerns

alternatives.name: HTTPie / xh
alternatives.what_they_miss_or_risks: The HTTPie GUI is proprietary and lacked HTTP/2 (2023 comment). xh is an open Rust clone

alternatives.name: Hurl
alternatives.why_people_move: Plain-text, curl-based, works well in CI. The poster of the May 2025 'logging secrets' thread switched to it
alternatives.what_they_miss_or_risks: No GUI; reusing requests is awkward

alternatives.name: .http files (VS Code REST Client, JetBrains HTTP Client, httpyac)
alternatives.why_people_move: Request files are committed alongside the code, with no cloud sync
alternatives.what_they_miss_or_risks: Can leave you 'almost entirely tied to VS Code and the REST Client extension'

alternatives.name: Kreya
alternatives.why_people_move: Offline, privacy-focused, data stays local, REST and gRPC, works with Git

alternatives.name: Thunder Client
alternatives.why_people_move: Handy because it lives inside the editor
alternatives.what_they_miss_or_risks: Proprietary. Pricing changes were criticised. Collections capped at 50 endpoints (2024 claim). Team features are paid

alternatives.name: Restfox
alternatives.why_people_move: Offline, Git-versioned, imports Postman collections (Show HN, 758 points, 2022)

alternatives.name: Paw / RapidAPI
alternatives.why_people_move: Native app with a one-time purchase

alternatives.name: Apidog / EchoAPI
alternatives.why_people_move: Free team tier, design + test + docs
alternatives.what_they_miss_or_risks: Most 'Postman alternatives 2026' articles are their own marketing. The Feb 2026 HN post was accused of being Apidog astroturfing

alternatives.name: New entrants in 2026: Voiden, appear.sh, APIFlow Studio
alternatives.why_people_move: Offline-first or Markdown-based. appear.sh offers 3 free seats
alternatives.what_they_miss_or_risks: Promoted by their own makers; adoption unproven

alternatives.name: Debuggers: Proxyman, Charles, HTTP Toolkit, Reqable, Requestly
alternatives.why_people_move: Not covered because time ran out. In the fetched threads mitmproxy appeared only as a traffic inspector and Burp only once

opportunities_for_our_app.idea: No account, fully offline by default, nothing depends on a cloud
opportunities_for_our_app.addresses: Forced login, outages, corporate bans, sign-in bugs

opportunities_for_our_app.idea: Free multi-user collaboration through readable, diff-friendly files in Git (the Bruno model) for saved requests, mock rules and environments
opportunities_for_our_app.addresses: Free plan limited to 1 user since Mar 2026; team lock-in

opportunities_for_our_app.idea: Secret safety by design: keep secrets in the OS keychain, never put them in exports, automatically redact Authorization/Cookie/API keys from HAR and collection exports, and scan for secrets before sharing
opportunities_for_our_app.addresses: CloudSEK and Truffle findings; Postman's confusing 'Initial value' and 'secret' fields

opportunities_for_our_app.idea: One-click import of Postman collections v2.1, environments and globals, plus open export that includes WebSocket and gRPC
Handle very large payloads: stream bodies to disk and use virtualised viewers. Target: a 250 MB response with no UI freeze. Publish the benchmark
opportunities_for_our_app.addresses: Postman crashes and hangs on large payloads

opportunities_for_our_app.idea: Capture, replay and save: turn intercepted traffic into editable requests, mockttp mock rules and assertions. This is a debugger-native workflow API clients do not own. Postman's own proxy/Interceptor was not checked
opportunities_for_our_app.addresses: Positions us as a debugger plus a light client rather than a Postman clone

opportunities_for_our_app.idea: AI only when the user opts in, using their own key or a local model, and never in onboarding
Let users choose how updates happen: off, notify or auto
Telemetry off by default or opt-in, with a documented list of what is sent and a single kill switch

A stable pricing promise: AGPL, free, no seats, no metering. Note that Postman Free already has unlimited runs and mocks, so 'unlimited' alone is not a differentiator; 'free for multiple users with no account' is
A performance budget with published benchmarks (cold start, idle RAM, large collections). Our app is also Electron, so we should not claim it is lighter without numbers
opportunities_for_our_app.addresses: Complaints about RAM and Electron weight

opportunities_for_our_app.idea: Simple UI for beginners that reveals advanced features gradually

counter_arguments: Postman v12 (Mar 2026) closed part of the gap: Native Git and local files, local and CI mocks, and unlimited runs and mocks on Free. 'Postman is cloud-only' is partly outdated. [high] https://blog.postman.com/new-capabilities-march-2026/ ; https://www.postman.com/pricing/

Postman is still rated highly: 4.6 on G2 (1,820 ratings) and 4.7 on Capterra (507). The pain is concentrated among developers who care about privacy, offline use or small teams. [medium] https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/reviews/reviews-list/prodview-2nezdpu4cqcac?page=14 ; https://www.capterra.com/p/188497/Postman/reviews/?page=2
Much of the 'alternatives' content is competitor marketing (Apidog, EchoAPI), so treat their numbers as illustrative. [high] https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46942116

Users expect any free tool to turn on them eventually (Insomnia in 2023, worries about Bruno's Golden Edition). Our 'free' promise needs a credible way to stay sustainable. [medium] https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=39653718
Postman is a whole API platform (docs, monitors, Flows, Catalog, governance). A debugger fork should not chase parity. [medium, analytical]
Our app is also Electron, so the RAM criticism of Postman applies to us too unless we measure and optimise. [medium, analytical]
